name: Peptides Weekly
tagline: Peptides, with the evidence read carefully.
description: Peptides Weekly is an education and awareness show. Every Thursday: the week in peptide science and regulation, and one peptide explained properly — what it is, how it works, what the studies show at each level of evidence, its regulatory status and its risks. Education only: never dosing, sourcing or protocols, and never medical advice.
